description:
Java Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Java Developer for a contract opportunity in Santa Clara, CA.
 

 Java Developer Job Details 
 

 Implementing a solution to secure workloads in virtualized datacenters and cloud environments. 
 Integrating security products into internal and external 3rd party solutions.
 Estimating task duration's and ensuring on-time delivery of components.
 Creating prototypes and for determining improvements to existing or new product architectures.
 Successfully communicating conceptual ideas and design rationale. 
  
 Java Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 5+ years’ experience in related field
 Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
 Java web development using open source ecosystem. 
 Experience with multi-threaded programming techniques.
 RESTful API server/client development. 
 Experience with Tomcat, Spring, Hibernate, SQL and other Open Source Tools (Git, MySQL, JUnit).
 Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies.
 Experience with HTML/CSS, Javascript, GWT and other UI frameworks a plus.
 Prior experience with ESXi, vCenter, NSX, OpenStack, KVM a plus.
 Strong background in Networking and Security is a plus.
 Familiarity with software defined networks. (OVS, OpenFlow, SDN controller a plus)
 Self-Motivated Individual with Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
 

 Java Developer Start Date 
 ASAP
 

 Java Developer Assignment Length 
 10+ months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
